knownWeaknesses: Teacher-scale footprint is far outside the compact runtime target and is acceptable only for offline distillation.
Repository access is gated and the exact training/distillation output-use conclusion still requires explicit review.
The full snapshot is teacher-scale and includes a very large text encoder, so it is not a compact runtime candidate.
Synthetic distillation output-use and exact immutable training snapshot still require separate admission evidence.
Gemma2-2B-IT text conditioning introduces a separate license chain that must be reviewed as part of the complete teacher pipeline.
The compact denoiser does not make the complete teacher pipeline compact because text conditioning remains multi-gigabyte.

rationale: No teacher is admitted until immutable source/checkpoint identities, exact toolchain evidence and distillation-output rights are content-addressed.
Teacher size is not a student-size target: a large teacher may be used offline when it improves quality, while the student is optimized separately.
Student size, latency or memory wins are accepted only after the required generation-quality floor passes; quality cannot be traded away merely to make the model smaller.
Installed footprint and working memory remain independent evidence axes under the BERS dual-budget law.
